nodes.name: Sklearn Ensemble Voting Aggregation Atoms
nodes.description: Estimator-independent aggregation helpers for sklearn ensemble voting estimators

nodes.name: voting_classifier_hard_labels
nodes.description: Choose each sample's class by sklearn's weighted hard-vote tie rule.
nodes.type_signature: (encoded_predictions: NDArray[np.int64], classes: NDArray[np.float64], weights: tuple[float, ...] | None = None) -> NDArray[np.float64]

nodes.name: voting_classifier_soft_probabilities
nodes.description: Average per-estimator class probabilities the way sklearn soft voting does.
nodes.type_signature: (probabilities: NDArray[np.float64], weights: tuple[float, ...] | None = None) -> NDArray[np.float64]

nodes.name: voting_regressor_average
nodes.description: Average per-estimator regression predictions the way sklearn voting regression does.
nodes.type_signature: (predictions: NDArray[np.float64], weights: tuple[float, ...] | None = None) -> NDArray[np.float64]
